question: Which hormone is responsible for the maintenance of the corpus luteum in the first days of implantation ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Chorionic gonadotropin -> Maintenance of the corpus luteum in the first days of implantation -> 95% CHAIN: Chorionic gonadotropin -> Stimulates the production of progesterone -> Corpus luteum maintenance -> 90% CHAIN: Chorionic gonadotropin -> Supports the endometrial lining -> Corpus luteum maintenance -> 95%
analysis: During the first days of implantation, the hormone responsible for the maintenance of the corpus luteum is Chorionic gonadotropin.
